using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
const long long W = 646;
const int SZ = 1 << 20;
long long warr[SZ];
long long winvarr[SZ];
long long szinv;

long long modPow(long long base, int exp) {
    if (exp == 0) return 1;
    if (exp % 2 == 1) return modPow(base, exp - 1) * base % MOD;
    long long half = modPow(base, exp / 2);
    return half * half % MOD;
}

long long modInverse(long long a, long long mod) {
    long long m0 = mod, y = 0, x = 1;
    if (mod == 1) return 0;
    while (a > 1) {
        long long q = a / mod;
        long long t = mod;
        mod = a % mod;
        a = t;
        t = y;
        y = x - q * y;
        x = t;
    }
    if (x < 0) x += m0;
    return x;
}

class Vector {
public:
    long long v[SZ];
    
    Vector(long* a) {
        for (int i = 0; i < SZ; i++) {
            v[i] = 0;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            v[i] = a[i];
        }
    }
    
    vector<long long> fft() {
        return dft(0, 1, true);
    }
    
    vector<long long> ifft() {
        vector<long long> x = dft(0, 1, false);
        for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
            x[i] = x[i] * szinv % MOD;
        }
        return x;
    }
    
    vector<long long> dft(int first, int pow, bool straight) {
        if (pow == SZ) {
            vector<long long> result = {v[first]};
            return result;
        }
        vector<long long> even = dft(first, 2 * pow, straight);
        vector<long long> odd = dft(first + pow, 2 * pow, straight);
        int n = even.size();
        vector<long long> result(2 * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long twiddle = straight ? warr[i * pow] : winvarr[i * pow];
            result[i] = (even[i] + twiddle * odd[i]) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long long twiddle = straight ? warr[i * pow] : winvarr[i * pow];
            result[n + i] = ((even[i] - twiddle * odd[i]) % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

vector<long long> fft(vector<long long> a) {
    int sz = 1 << 20;
    vector<long long> result(sz, 0);
    long long wth = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < sz; i++) {
        long long x = 1;
        for (int j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
            result[i] = (result[i] + a[j] * x) % MOD;
            x = x * wth % MOD;
        }
        wth = wth * W % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}

vector<long long> power(vector<long long> arr, int exp) {
    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        arr[i] = modPow(arr[i], exp);
    }
    return arr;
}

class FastScanner {
public:
    ifstream* file;
    string line;
    int pos;
    bool isFile;
    
    FastScanner(const string& filename) {
        file = new ifstream(filename);
        isFile = true;
    }
    
    FastScanner() {
        isFile = false;
        pos = 0;
    }
    
    ~FastScanner() {
        if (isFile && file) {
            file->close();
            delete file;
        }
    }
    
    string nextLine() {
        if (isFile) {
            string line;
            if (file && getline(*file, line)) {
                return line;
            }
            return "";
        } else {
            string line;
            if (getline(cin, line)) {
                return line;
            }
            return "";
        }
    }
    
    string next() {
        if (isFile) {
            string token;
            *file >> token;
            return token;
        } else {
            string token;
            cin >> token;
            return token;
        }
    }
    
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    
    double nextDouble() {
        return stod(next());
    }
};

void solve() {
    FastScanner in;
    int n = in.nextInt();
    int k = in.nextInt();
    long long arr[10] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        arr[in.nextInt()] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<long long> vecArr(arr, arr + 10);
    vector<long long> x = fft(vecArr);
    x = power(x, n / 2);
    
    Vector v(arr);
    x = v.ifft();
    
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
        ans = (ans + x[i] * x[i]) % MOD;
    }
    cout << ans << endl;
}

int main() {
    // Initialize warr and winvarr
    warr[0] = 1;
    winvarr[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < SZ; i++) {
        warr[i] = warr[i - 1] * W % MOD;
        winvarr[i] = winvarr[i - 1] * W % MOD;
    }
    szinv = modInverse(SZ, MOD);
    
    solve();
    return 0;
}
